```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = {
    "StichtagDat": ["2024-12-31", "2025-12-31", "2019-12-31", "2020-12-31", "2021-12-31"],
    "StichtagDatJahr": [2024, 2025, 2019, 2020, 2021],
    "KreisLang": ["Kreis 7", "Kreis 7", "Kreis 10", "Kreis 10", "Kreis 10"],
    "AnzHunde": [1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
    "Rasse1Text": ["Deutsche Dogge", "Deutsche Dogge", "Continental Bulldog", "Continental Bulldog", "Continental Bulldog"]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(data=df, x='StichtagDatJahr', hue='Rasse1Text', palette='viridis')

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Year')
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.title('Number of Dogs by Year and Breed')
plt.legend(title='Breed')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Save the plot as a PNG file
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.close()
```
